description: This file contains serialization utility functions for string conversions, hex encoding/decoding, base64 encoding, and Unicode code point handling within the Thunder::Core namespace.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts wide character string to std::string or vice versa, with platform-specific handling.

methods.name: ToHexString
methods.description: Encodes byte arrays into hexadecimal string representation, with optional delimiter.

methods.name: FromHexString
methods.description: Decodes hexadecimal string into byte array, handling delimiters and odd length.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Encodes byte array into base64 string, with optional padding.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Decodes base64 string into byte array, handling padding and ignore characters.

methods.name: CodePointToUTF16
methods.description: Converts a Unicode code point to UTF-16 surrogate pair if needed.

methods.name: UTF16ToCodePoint
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 surrogate pair to a Unicode code point.

methods.name: ToCodePoint
methods.description: Decodes a UTF-8 sequence to a Unicode code point.

methods.name: FromCodePoint
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode code point into UTF-8 sequence.

methods.name: ToQuotedString
methods.description: Escapes internal quotes in a string and wraps it with specified quote character.
